messages:
Marta (Sales): Quick handoff — contract signed with VeroHealth (12mo enterprise, ORD-5821). They need Private deployment (VPC peering), Okta SSO, and an on-prem connector for PHI ingestion. Renewal sensitivity: medium if onboarding >2 weeks. Uploading deal attachments.
Elena (CS): Thanks — taking this on. Can you post the IdP metadata + infra contact? Also any early red flags on usage or billing expectations?
Marta (Sales): Contact: ali.vero@verohealth.com, infra: rachel@it. IdP metadata: https://idp.vero/saml/metadata . They expect token usage report for billing estimate — roughly 2M tokens/mo projected in pilot.
Elena (CS): Ok — I'll draft a kickoff runbook. Propose Wed 10:00 PT for kickoff (CS enablement + Eng for private deploy). Priya and Jon — can you join?
Priya (Support): Wed 10:00 PT works. I'll prepare SSO verification checklist and mock accounts.
Jon (Eng): I can do the private deploy section. Need CIDR and peering window from their infra. Marta — please request allowed IPs.
Marta (Sales): VPC CIDR is 10.50.0.0/16. Rachel will share VPN creds. They also require an on-prem connector; confirm that was included in the order (it is, ORD-5821).
Elena (CS): Created triage ticket: CS-1283 "VeroHealth onboarding: SSO + VPC peering + connector". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-1283
OpsBot: Ticket CS-1283 created by Elena (CS) and assigned to Jon (Eng).
Jon (Eng): Assigned. Added subtasks ENG-4451 (deployment script) and ENG-4452 (connector packaging). I'll estimate timelines shortly.
Priya (Support): I'll add verification cases: SSO sign-in test, SCIM sync check, data retention verification. Need a sample test account and S3 access from Vero.
Elena (CS): Owners & immediate next steps (also added to CS-1283):\n- Elena (CS): overall owner, kickoff + enablement (kickoff Wed 10:00 PT)\n- Jon (Eng): private deploy + connector packaging (ENG-4451, ENG-4452)\n- Priya (Support): SSO tests & runbook (due +2 days after kickoff)\n- Marta (Sales): obtain VPN creds & infra contacts (due EOD today)\n- Rachel (Vero infra): provide peering window & creds\nPlease react with :white_check_mark: if clear.
Marta (Sales): ✅
Jon (Eng): ✅ I'll triage ENG tasks today.
Priya (Support): ✅ prepping checklist.
Elena (CS): Renewal risk note: marking as "medium" because of onboarding complexity. Recommend weekly health-check emails and success metrics: 95th/50th latency targets (<500ms) and a token-usage weekly report. Adding success criteria to CS-1283.
Marta (Sales): They also asked for a sample monthly usage forecast. Elena — can you produce a baseline after week 1?
Elena (CS): Yes — will add a baseline report template into CS-1283 and produce after week 1.
Jon (Eng): One engineering blocker: connector requires Python 3.10 and access to their S3. Marta — please confirm S3 bucket name and an IAM role with read access.
Marta (Sales): S3: s3://vero-dumps-prod. Rachel will provision read role and share ARN.
Priya (Support): FYI — scheduling a dry-run SSO test during kickoff and collecting logs. Example SAML validation curl (for runbook):\n``\ncurl -i -X POST "https://idp.vero/saml/validate" -d 'sample_assertion=...' -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded"\n```
Elena (CS): Added that sample to the runbook. Final ask: Jon — ETA to "ready for smoke" once peering is established?
Jon (Eng): ETA: ~2 business days after peering + 1 day connector packaging + 0.5 day smoke = ~4 business days total. Updating ENG subtasks with ETAs.
Marta (Sales): I'll push peering request today and post confirmation in this thread.
Elena (CS): Summary saved in CS-1283. Follow-ups: Marta to post peering confirmation here; Jon/ Priya/ Elena to update CS-1283 with ETAs and test cases. React when done. Closing handoff for now.
Priya (Support): Thanks — will follow up in CS-1283 and calendar. :rocket:
OpsBot: Reminder — Kickoff meeting Wed 2024-05-15 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
